nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Overlays the native 'Flag state of catching vessel(s)' <select> with a type-ahead combobox; the a11y tree shows a 'combobox' plus a text input (id=flag-state-1) sitting in front of the real select (name=flag-state-1, id=flag-state-1-select).
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Third-party accessible-autocomplete progressive-enhancement widget layered over a govuk Select. The new app should decide whether flag-state needs autocomplete over a 251-item list; if so use the GOV.UK accessible-autocomplete pattern deliberately, otherwise a plain govuk Select.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK 'Select' component, or the GDS accessible-autocomplete enhancement pattern

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: defra-datepicker, date-picker__container, date-picker__dialog, date-picker__button__*, date-picker__reveal__icon, short-date-input, date-input--picker
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: A bespoke DEFRA calendar date-picker bolted onto the Date of issue govuk-date-input — adds a 'Choose date' icon button opening a month-grid dialog (Previous month / Next month / Cancel, heading e.g. 'July 2026').
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom calendar widget outside the Design System. GOV.UK guidance prefers the plain three-field Date input for known dates. The new app should default to the standard Date input and only add a picker if there is a proven user need.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK 'Date input' component (three text fields, no calendar)

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Bespoke IPAFFS grid/table CSS used to lay out the Commodity code / Species checkbox rows and column widths.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom layout classes duplicate what govuk-grid-* / govuk-table could do. The species picker is a checkbox-per-row table; rebuild with a GOV.UK Table or govuk-grid columns rather than bespoke percentage-width classes.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: <button> elements styled to look like links — used for 'Save and return to manage catch certificates' and 'Save and return to hub'.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Buttons rendered as links is a GDS anti-pattern for primary/secondary submit actions. Use a real secondary govuk-button (govuk-button--secondary) or a proper link, not a button masquerading as a link.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK 'Button' with govuk-button--secondary, or a standard link

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Screen-reader live-region / visually-hidden status text for the autocomplete and date-picker widgets.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: These exist to patch a11y for the custom widgets above; they disappear if the standard govuk components are used. Not a requirement in themselves — a symptom of the bespoke widgets.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Not needed once standard govuk Select / Date input are used (they ship their own a11y)

fields.name: number-of-catch-certificates
fields.label: Number of catch certificates in this attachment
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditionally mandatory as the old system had it: when the Change disclosure's Update action or either save-and-return action validates the attachment count, Joi requires a numeric value; the valid range is 1 to 20 (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:33-40,76-105; service/src/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details.js:47-73).
fields.requiredNote: The rendered trace did not mark this control as required. The QA page object does not expose it and the fish workflow does not change it, so QA provides no evidence about whether it is mandatory or what values are accepted.
fields.conditionalOn: Displayed read-only as '1 catch certificates' in a summary list; editable via the 'Change' Details disclosure. Drives how many catch-certificate accordion sections render.
fields.evidence: trace db2d277c5c8bfcf2dc0f2278bc92dc7aa8fdf42d action 46; no counterpart in page-objects/notification/AddCatchCertificateDetailsPage.ts:4-40 or workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:916-923

fields.name: catch-certificate-reference-1
fields.label: Catch certificate reference
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for every certificate section validated by Save and continue, Update, or save-and-return: Joi.string().required() maps missing and empty values to "Enter the catch certificate reference" (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:42-60,107-145).
fields.requiredNote: The rendered trace did not mark this input as required. QA always supplies a generated reference on its happy path but has no omission test or validation assertion, so server-side mandatory status remains a gap.
fields.conditionalOn: The IUU catch-certificate details page has been opened for an uploaded attachment; one input per catch-certificate accordion section (suffix -N).

fields.name: date-of-issue-day-1 / date-of-issue-month-1 / date-of-issue-year-1
fields.label: Date of issue
fields.hint: Day / Month / Year (rendered as govuk-hint labels on each sub-field)
fields.requiredEvidence: Explicitly optional as the old system had it: dateValidation is called with required:false. If any part is supplied, the shared validator enforces completeness, ranges, a real calendar date, and today-or-in-the-past (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:113-123; service/src/validation/date_validator.js:81-96).
fields.requiredNote: The rendered trace did not mark the date inputs as required. QA always fills all three parts on its happy path but has no partial/empty-date test or validation assertion, so server-side mandatory and date-validity rules remain gaps.
fields.conditionalOn: The IUU catch-certificate details page has been opened for an uploaded attachment; one date per catch-certificate section (suffix -N). Augmented by the custom defra-datepicker 'Choose date' calendar.

fields.name: flag-state-1 (select id=flag-state-1-select; autocomplete input id=flag-state-1)
fields.label: Flag state of catching vessel(s)
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for every certificate section validated by Save and continue, Update, or save-and-return: Joi.string().required() maps missing and empty values to "Enter the flag state of the catching vessel(s)", then the handler verifies the submitted code exists in country reference data (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:61-65,136-160).
fields.requiredNote: The rendered trace did not mark the underlying select as required. QA always chooses a flag state on its happy path but has no omission test or validation assertion, so server-side mandatory status remains a gap.
fields.referenceData: Country reference data. QA uses the visible label 'France'; the test domain vocabulary maps France to 'FR'.
fields.conditionalOn: The IUU catch-certificate details page has been opened for an uploaded attachment; one flag state per catch-certificate section (suffix -N).
fields.evidence: trace db2d277c5c8bfcf2dc0f2278bc92dc7aa8fdf42d action 46 — country list (250 countries + placeholder), reference data; action 48 after snapshot — autocomplete value France and underlying select value FR; page-objects/notification/AddCatchCertificateDetailsPage.ts:23-25; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:819,827,920-921; tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-notification.spec.ts:210-216; types/country.ts:80

fields.name: select-all-checkbox-1
fields.label: Select all
fields.requiredEvidence: The select-all convenience checkbox is not included in the authorised page-validation schema, so it is not mandatory as the old system had it (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/partials/importer/catchCertificateDetails.html:138-153; service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:28-73,107-145).
fields.requiredNote: This convenience toggle itself is not shown as required. QA checks it on the happy path, which establishes the bulk-selection behaviour but does not prove that using Select all, or selecting at least one species, is mandatory.
fields.conditionalOn: The IUU catch-certificate details page has been opened for an uploaded attachment; select-all toggle for the species checkbox group in each catch-certificate section.
fields.evidence: trace db2d277c5c8bfcf2dc0f2278bc92dc7aa8fdf42d action 49 after snapshot — select-all-checkbox-1 is checked; page-objects/notification/AddCatchCertificateDetailsPage.ts:27-29; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:922

fields.name: species-1756325-1
fields.label: species-1756325-1 (row: Commodity code 03019230 — Species 'Anguilla spp.')
fields.requiredEvidence: Dynamic species checkbox keys are not included in the authorised page-validation schema, which is declared unknown() and validates reference, flag state and date only; therefore selecting at least one species is not mandatory on this legacy page (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/partials/importer/catchCertificateDetails.html:165-190; service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:42-73,107-145).
fields.requiredNote: The rendered checkbox is not marked required. QA selects it indirectly with Select all and has no zero-species validation assertion, so whether at least one species is server-side mandatory remains a gap.
observedValues: Anguilla spp. (commodity code 03019230), selected through Select all
fields.conditionalOn: The IUU catch-certificate details page has been opened for an uploaded attachment. One checkbox appears per commodity/species row previously added to the consignment; the set is dynamic and driven by the notification's commodities.
fields.evidence: trace db2d277c5c8bfcf2dc0f2278bc92dc7aa8fdf42d action 49 after snapshot — species-1756325-1 is checked through Select all; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:866-874,922; types/commodity-code.ts:5; types/species.ts:10

fields.name: attachmentId
fields.label: (catch-certificate attachment identifier)
fields.requiredEvidence: The template always posts the current document attachmentId and the handler uses it to locate the attachment and apply number/detail updates (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/addCatchCertificateDetails.html:40-43; service/src/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details.js:38-50). This is required server-generated journey state, not user-entered mandatoriness.
fields.conditionalOn: always present on this attachment-specific page

fields.name: catch-certificate-id-{index}
fields.label: (existing catch-certificate identifier)
fields.requiredEvidence: Only emitted for an already-saved certificate detail. It is not part of the required validation schema; the handler uses it to route removal of an existing certificate, while an unsaved certificate can be removed without an id (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/partials/importer/catchCertificateDetails.html:1-3; service/src/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details.js:57-64).
fields.conditionalOn: the certificate section represents already-saved details

routing.description: IUU catch-certificate boundary page reached from 'Manage catch certificates' by choosing 'Add details' for a newly uploaded attachment. The QA happy path fills the details and 'Save and continue' returns to the manage-catch-certificates loop, where the user can upload another certificate or answer No and leave the catch-certificate step.
routing.precedingPage: manage-catch-certificates (via 'Add details' for an uploaded attachment)
routing.shownWhen: The fish/IUU catch-certificate route is active, a catch certificate attachment has been uploaded, and its 'Add details' link is followed.

testAssertions.assertion: The happy-path detail submission supplies a generated catch-certificate reference, a complete date of issue, the flag state 'France', selects all displayed species, and activates 'Save and continue'.
After catch-certificate details are saved, each uploaded certificate must appear on Review with its generated reference, flag state 'France', and uploaded attachment filename.
QA does not exercise the attachment-level 'Number of catch certificates' editor, an individual species checkbox, or either secondary save action; those controls remain trace-only requirements.

openQuestions: Validation copy is unknown — no errored trace was mined for this page. Which of reference / date of issue / flag state / species are mandatory, and what are the exact error messages?

LEGACY RESOLUTION / POLICY POINT: each catch-certificate reference and flag state is mandatory; date of issue is optional but validated when supplied; neither Select all nor the dynamic species checkbox keys are validated, so zero species is accepted by this legacy page handler (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:42-73,107-145). Confirm whether the IUU rebuild should intentionally make date and at least one species mandatory.

LEGACY RESOLUTION: changing the attachment count requires a numeric value from 1 to 20 and cannot reduce it below the number of detail records already saved (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/add_catch_certificate_details_validation.js:76-105; constants at service/src/utils/validation_constants.js:334-346).

The page uses a per-attachment loop: each attachment can hold N catch certificates (number-of-catch-certificates), each an accordion section with its own reference/date/flag-state/species. After saving, the journey returns to 'Manage catch certificates' (ManageCatchCertificatesPage) with an 'Upload more catch certificates? Yes/No' loop — confirm the loop boundary and how 'Save and return to manage catch certificates' vs 'Save and continue' differ.
Species checkbox set is derived from the consignment's commodities (only fishery-product commodity codes). Confirm the filter rule and whether species can be zero.

Date of issue and Flag state use custom widgets (defra-datepicker, accessible-autocomplete). Confirm whether the rebuild keeps the calendar picker / autocomplete or reverts to the plain GOV.UK Date input + Select.
This whole page is conditional on the consignment containing fishery products; confirm the exact commodity/IUU trigger that gates it.

IUU JOURNEY BOUNDARY: this catch-certificate page has moved to a separate IUU journey and should be treated as a CHED-P-to-IUU boundary page, not an ordinary page in the core CHED-P rebuild. Confirm which service owns the page, the hand-off/navigation contract, and whether this legacy CHED-P-shaped URL remains part of the integration boundary.

The main CHED-P accessibility workflow does not traverse the fish/IUU catch-certificate branch: it goes from Commodity Additional Details to Latest Health Certificate (tests/accessibility/ched-p-accessibility-tests.spec.ts:80-89). Where is equivalent accessibility coverage for this IUU boundary page?
